title: herdr-peers lead record (lead-v1)
description: What `herdr-peers lead show --json` prints and what a lead notice carries on its `swarm-lead:` line: who leads one plan, at which epoch, who succeeds it and which lanes it notifies. Stored per plan in the helper's machine-scoped state (0600). Only the holder of the highest epoch acts as lead; receivers accept a new record only through the fencing rules (protocol.md §12). Producers may add keys only in a new schema version: receivers reject unknown keys. Never carries prompt text, secrets or paths.

plan.description: The plan id (--plan, else the basename of $DWP_PLAN).

lead.description: The lead's address as the holder of this record reaches it; null after `lead release`.

epoch.description: 1 for a first claim; +1 on every handover, takeover, release and claim after a release (1..1000000).

succession.description: Successors in order (at most 32, no duplicates, never the lead). The first reachable one takes over when the lead is gone.

lanes.description: Lanes that receive every lead notice (at most 32, no duplicates, never the lead).

updated_at.description: UTC time this holder last wrote the record.
